item.intoxicantes.guia_snc.lore: Everything you need to explore the SNC Adventures.
guia.intoxicantes.entregue: §eThe SNC Adventures Guide dropped in your backpack. Right-click to open.
guia.intoxicantes.cat.comecando.sub: What the SNC Adventures is and what to do first
guia.intoxicantes.cat.bebidas.sub: Cachaça, beer, rum, wine and mead
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.rede.1: The panel receives power from an adjacent SNC Energies source. Passive cable links the components; the front output feeds circuit 1, while the side and rear outputs select the others. Right-click the panel to open its GUI.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.rede.quad: Four independent circuits: edit their names, breaker, 127/220 V and state in the GUI. Three seconds of overcurrent trips the breaker; reset it manually.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.rede.said: Wire one panel output continuously to its load. Front=C1, right=C2, rear=C3, left=C4. Never join outputs or panels: protection trips. Loads are terminals, not wires. Wire switches in series with no parallel cable bypass.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.rede.inte: Click to turn it on or off. When off, the grid beyond the switch loses power.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.rede.soqu: Sockets accept 5 to 20 W LED bulbs, not floodlights or high-bays. Click with a bulb to install or swap; an empty hand removes it. Swapping returns the previous bulb with its data intact. Light follows installed wattage.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.rede.toma: Outlets power adjacent LED fixtures and draw nothing on their own. Directly placed bulbs, floodlights and high-bays also require energized cable or an outlet. Clicking only toggles the local switch; it never creates energy.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.rede.dica: SNC Energies integration is optional: without it, the panel has no source and the installation stays unpowered.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.bitolas.1: Each segment carries only loads routed through it, not other branches. Five one-second cable-overcurrent readings trip protection; three breaker-overcurrent readings trip the breaker. No energy means no current or overload. Ratings are simplified gameplay values.
1.5 mm² — up to 10 A; recommended for lighting.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.bitolas.2: 2.5 mm² — up to 20 A; recommended for outlets.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.bitolas.1: 10 mm² — up to 63 A; main feed.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.bitolas.d: Use the multimeter to check cable size, circuit, power and installation state.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.cabo_susp: Copper cable links neighbouring blocks. When the installation has to cross a yard, a roof or any other gap, use the connector and the spool: the hanging span links two distant points without filling the space with blocks, and the panel reads the link as part of the same circuit.

The Cable Connector clamps onto the face of a panel, socket, outlet, switch, copper cable or an SNC Energies generator. It only installs with a support; removing the block behind drops the connector and cuts the cable.

With the spool of the span gauge: the first click locks the origin on a connector, the second one stretches the cable to the other connector (up to 32 blocks). Sneak-click with the spool reels the cable in and returns the spool. One spool builds one span; the gauge is the current limit of the span, and 5 measurements of overload trip the breaker just like block cable.

The suspended cable neither collides with blocks nor carries a load of its own: it is a wire between two terminals. Multiple spans can form branches on one connector; each span carries only its own loads. Joining different circuit outputs causes a wiring conflict and trips their breakers.
guia.intoxicantes.eletricidade.multimetr: Use the multimeter on a panel, cable, switch, socket or outlet to inspect it. Use it in the air to query the nearest panel.
The meter reports values known to the grid: energy, draw, LED wattage, cable current rating and circuit state.
If no panel is nearby, the search mode says so instead of inventing a reading.
guia.intoxicantes.comecando.sobre.1: This book is the street manual: how to plant, crush, ferment, distill, age, bottle, spend — and how NOT to get scammed on credit. Nothing here is real: it's Minecraft with a bar accent.
guia.intoxicantes.comecando.sobre.2: Start with your first R$, find the Esquinão near the village and follow the beer smell.

guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.vinho.barril: 4 grape juice per batch; ferments and ages in the same barrel; bottle with glass bottles.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.cachaca.efeito: Strength II (45s), Nausea (20s) and Slowness (15s) — the white one is truly strong.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.cachaca.dica: Crusher bagasse burns in the furnace: the distillery fuels itself.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.rum.efeitos: Fire Resistance (60s) and Nausea (15s) — the adventurer's fuel.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.cerveja.duas_d: The tun asks for two doses
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.cerveja.efeito: Strength I (45s) and Nausea (10s) — the bar classic.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.hidromel.1: No machine chain: honey bottle + bottles at the crafting table yield 2.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.hidromel.recei: Each extra bottle in the grid yields more mead
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.hidromel.efeit: Absorption (60s) and Nausea (10s) — sweetness with a kick.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.1: Plant the seed on dirt or farmland, with a fence on one of its four sides. The seedling stays rooted in the ground; its branches wrap around the wood you built.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.semente: SNC grape seed bag. Seeds: vines (20%), jungle leaves (5%).
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.produto: Each visible bunch: %s grape. Up to %s on a full canopy.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.uv: UV ripens each bunch and enables a perfect harvest; every bunch still yields one grape.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.2: Stack fences beside the seedling and connect more fences at the top to build an arbor. Without support it stays small; a single post is not enough for fruit. Disconnected fences do not receive branches. Bone meal helps growth but cannot skip cultivation time.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.interagir: With an empty main hand or while holding grapes, use a bunch directly or its exact supporting canopy fence. Ten bunches mean ten grapes, harvested one at a time. Only the selected bunch disappears; the others, branches and leaves remain. Harvested grapes share the same 3D bunch shape seen on the vine, including in your inventory and hand.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.rebrota: Each bunch returns after at least %s s with light and support.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.poda: Each bunch has its own ripening and regrowth, saved with the world. Without light or support, its timer pauses. A new fence must grow its own fruit. Pruning and replacing supports cannot reset or speed up production.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uva.legado: Older worlds preserve age, UV and any recovery already underway. Breaking the root returns seeds and only the grapes still present; harvested bunches are never duplicated.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.lupulo.1: The beer seasoning. Plants on dirt; the tun's 2nd dose is his.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.lupulo.produt: Harvest: fresh hop (3 at max UV)
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.lupulo.uv: UV: doubles the harvest at max
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.lupulo.2: No hop means no boil end — the tun keeps waiting.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.cafe.1: Hangover's enemy. Harvest green, extract caffeine and return to combat.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.cafe.produto: Harvest: green coffee (3 at max UV)
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.cafe.2: Caffeine extract is crafted from green coffee (crafting).
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.maconha.1: The corner herb. Harvest the silk and roll the joint.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.maconha.2: Silk + paper at the crafting table = joint.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.papoula.1: The opium flower. Vanilla poppy drops both seed and sap.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.papoula.produ: Harvest: opium straight from the flower (35%)
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.papoula.2: Opium is a street anesthetic: resistance with a cost.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.cevada.1: The cold cereal. Grows wild in plains and taiga.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.cevada.produt: Harvest: up to 4 barley at the mature stage
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.cevada.uv: UV: speeds the cycle (does not double the harvest)
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.cevada.2: Roast in the furnace into malt — the tun's 1st dose.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uv.1: The UV lamp replaces the sun: indoor growing, at night, in the rain.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uv.2: Range 2 (5×5×5); can be turned off by redstone. Grows beyond the normal stage.
guia.intoxicantes.cultivos.uv.dica: No power (redstone off) and ripening stops on time.
guia.intoxicantes.fermentacao.dorna.1: The fermentation barrel turns raw juice into fermented juice — the step before the still.
guia.intoxicantes.fermentacao.dorna.2: Right-click opens the GUI; SHIFT + input in hand loads; SHIFT + empty hand draws the wash. Bubbles mark the process.
The still distills and CONCENTRATES: 4 fermented juice yield 2 young spirit.
Serves cachaça and rum (and future spirits) — the machine is generic, the recipe decides.
guia.intoxicantes.fermentacao.barris.1: Each drink has its OWN barrel (the label comes on craft). The barrel ferments and/or ages and yields the batch.
guia.intoxicantes.fermentacao.barris.2: Ready? SHIFT with a glass bottle bottles one drink at a time (or insert it via the GUI).
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.moenda.1: Crushes cane into juice. The bagasse burns in the furnace.
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.moenda.2: SHIFT + 4 canes to load; SHIFT + empty hand draws the juice. Right-click opens the GUI.
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.prensa.1: Crushes and strains grapes into juice — the wine begins here.
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.prensa.2: SHIFT + 6 grapes to load; SHIFT + empty hand draws the juice. Right-click opens the GUI.
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.caldeirao.1: Mashing and boiling in one station. Needs WATER below (source or filled cauldron).
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.caldeirao.2: 2nd dose: when the mash ends, SHIFT + 1 hop for the final boil (or insert via the GUI).
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.interacao.her: Hands on: how to use the machines
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.interacao.1: Every SNC machine speaks the same language: RIGHT-click opens the GUI, SHIFT + item in hand inserts, SHIFT + empty hand collects the output.
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.interacao.gui: Right-click opens the GUI: the machine's living scene, the batch bar and the accepted recipes panel
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.interacao.ins: SHIFT + click with the input in hand: inserts the right dose without opening the GUI
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.interacao.rec: SHIFT + empty hand collects the finished product — the classic route, faster than ever
guia.intoxicantes.maquinas.interacao.dic: In the GUI the scene ANIMATES with the real batch (bubbles, steam, drips) — moving means running; still means empty or waiting
guia.intoxicantes.armas.escopeta.1: 5-shell pump-action: close shots, pump between shots, aim by holding RIGHT CLICK.
guia.intoxicantes.armas.escopeta.reparo: Repairs at the anvil with 2 shells
guia.intoxicantes.armas.escopeta.dica: Press R to reload while walking.
guia.intoxicantes.armas.revolver.1: 6-round cylinder, more precise and stronger per bullet than the 12. Aim by holding RIGHT CLICK.
guia.intoxicantes.armas.revolver.reparo: Repairs at the anvil with 2 .38 cartridges
guia.intoxicantes.mobs.gago.1: Only shows up at the Esquinão Market (generated near villages), open 24h. BEVERAGE bar: buys beverage crops, sells drinks, glassware and exclusives — drugs are the dealer's business.
guia.intoxicantes.mobs.gago.arma: Careful: hitting the market (or him) draws the 12 for 30s.
guia.intoxicantes.mobs.gago.dica: Typed GAGO in chat near him? He comes after you. Tested.
guia.intoxicantes.mobs.traficante.1: Spawns walking near players; opens his spot with daily stock and the street rate. DRUGS ONLY: sells, buys the raw crops you grow and writes down the credit — drinks are the Gago's business.
guia.intoxicantes.mobs.traficante.dica: Unpaid credit costs trust: the limit shrinks.
guia.intoxicantes.mobs.juca.1: Jucelino: the Matanza band's big guy. Smokes Camel, mocks Gago and sells the merch.
guia.intoxicantes.mobs.juca.camisa: Sells the Matanza Shirt (wearer doesn't burn)
guia.intoxicantes.especiais.baseado.1: Columnar like vanilla: hold right-click and drag. Own smoke included.
guia.intoxicantes.especiais.cigarro_came: Juça's cigarette. Buy at the door or from him.
guia.intoxicantes.especiais.opio.1: Street anesthetic: cheap tank with a heavy cost.
guia.intoxicantes.especiais.lsd.1: Tiny paper on the tongue: the world bends. Don't use near edges.
guia.intoxicantes.especiais.camisa_matan: PERMANENT Fire Resistance while worn (leather chest)
Took the shirt off, the power goes with it. Buy from Juça.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.poste_luz.1: 3-block column that lights itself at 7pm and turns off at 5am — light lives only at the top.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.asfalto.1: The parking lot's dense floor. Pairs with the crosswalk and the lamp.
Flat block (1px) over the asphalt: walk on top without a step. Vanishes if the ground gives way.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.hidrante.1: Decorative, with a comedic water jet on use. The whole corner is interactive.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.lampada_led.1: LED tube suspended by two rods, milky-market-white diffuser. Always on for now — switching and wiring come later.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.lampada_potenci: Ten wattages just like real life: 5, 9, 12, 15 and 20W (residential bulb), 30 and 50W (floodlight), 100, 150 and 200W (industrial high-bay). The higher the watt, the stronger the light — 200W lights the whole shed.

Crafting is a LADDER: the 5W bulb is glass+torch; each next watt uses the previous one + glass + glowstone (bulb), iron (floodlight) or diamond (high-bay). Click toggles on/off; swap a dead bulb by clicking with another one in hand.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.prateleira_merc: The market sells eight drinks and 50 foods/ingredients. The gondola is now a HALF-BLOCK island: NINE products on the front and NINE on the back, with price tags in both aisles. SLAP it with the LEFT button to add the product to the cart (each slap adds; sneak+left adds the whole row) — the register display adds it up instantly. Pay at the COUNTER with the Gago. Right-click with an item restocks the clicked side; sneak+item picks it back (sneak+left breaks the gondola). Sneak+sprint (Shift+Ctrl by default) lowers the camera to inspect labels.

Deliveries arrive every Wednesday and fill BOTH sides: the back receives the ALTERNATE section, so the double row of the hall never repeats stock between aisles. Replenishment remembers each slot product, fills up to the stack limit and leaves different items untouched; old stocks and 9-slot saves keep working. Barley bread, coconut and grapes: sneak and use the top of a table to place one unit; an empty hand picks it up.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.caixa_mercado.h: The counter with a fixed Gago
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.caixa_mercado.1: The counter comes in TWO HALVES: a laminate body with a steel base and a 3D register on top (green display, keypad and cash drawer). The display shows YOUR CART TOTAL in real time. The nearest Gago is assigned to the back post and stands fixed (NoAI) — without him the register is closed.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.caixa_mercado.2: Note products by slapping the gondolas and click the counter to open your cart: adjust doses with +/−, drop what you don't want and confirm. The register display shows your cart total in real time. The server re-quotes everything on the spot — if stock or price changed, the purchase is refused with no charge. Cancel never costs anything. Payment is single: one debit, one delivery, and items, inventory and money are restored if anything fails.
Black panel with green LED text, rendered by code. Flips OPEN/CLOSED with the store hours.
guia.intoxicantes.blocos.painel_led.1: Thin programmable panel via the Command Center (remote): text, color, brightness and mode.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.real.1: The R$ 1 coin comes from zombies (15%), piglins (25%) and emerald trades. Two coins become the 2 bill on a crafting table.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.real.2: Player commands: /saldo (check), /depositar (all R$ becomes balance, adding each bill's FACE VALUE), /sacar N (balance becomes bills with correct change), /pagar (transfer).
guia.intoxicantes.economia.real.dica: Emerald = R$ 1 coin; emerald block = 9 coins.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.notas.hero: Every bill is worth its face
guia.intoxicantes.economia.notas.1: The full family: 1 coin, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200 bills and the commemorative 500. /depositar adds face value (one 200 bill deposits R$ 200, not 1) and /sacar returns exact change — R$ 340 comes out as 200 + 100 + 2×20.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.notas.2: Bills exchange on a crafting table: combine to go up (2×100 = 200), break to go down (200 = 2×100). Nothing is lost: every exchange is exact.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.nota500.1: Golden, engraved with the dolphin — the Republic of SNC's commemorative edition. It never comes off a crafting table: the WITHER always drops one when it falls. Worth a true R$ 500 in /depositar and joins the /sacar change.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.nota500.dica: R$ 32,000 in one stack of 64 five-hundreds — the tightest chest on the corner.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.fiado.1: No R$? The Dealer sells on credit (R$ 50 initial limit) and notes the debt.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.fiado.juros: Interest per tab: 10% with no credit, 30% on trust and 0% on your word (pay up to level up)
guia.intoxicantes.economia.fiado.quitaca: Settle: interact with the spot and pay
guia.intoxicantes.economia.fiado.dica: A deadbeat loses trust: the credit limit shrinks.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.cotacao.1: At the dealer's SPOT, substance prices float daily (0.7x to 1.4x; label = charge). Buy on the cheap day.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.cotacao.marku: At Gago's bar: drunks and desperate pay more (capped at +30%)
guia.intoxicantes.efeitos.tabela.ressaca: Hangover: back to zero charges the morning
guia.intoxicantes.efeitos.tabela.dica: Coffee kills the hangover: caffeine extract clears the weakness.

gui.intoxicantes.ponto.bebe_no_gago: §9Beverage crops belong to the Gago, at the Esquinão

gui.intoxicantes.ponto.fiado_dica2: Settled the debt 2x: trusted (30%). 4x: on your word (0%)

gui.intoxicantes.ponto.pagar_dica1: Pays everything in your wallet, becomes the street's trusted
gui.intoxicantes.ponto.pagar_fiado: Pay the debt (all cash on hand)
gui.intoxicantes.ponto.pedir_fiado: Lend me some! (R$ 50 on the spot)
gui.intoxicantes.ponto.quita_juros: pay it all = trust level goes up
gui.intoxicantes.ponto.sem_divida_rodape: Clean name on the street lol · drinks at the Gago's
gui.intoxicantes.barril.garrafa_dica: §7Bottles with glass bottles OR with THIS drink's §fEMPTY§7 (the glass that comes back when you drink)
gui.intoxicantes.maquina.moenda_cana.fas: Done! Take the cane juice (+ bagasse)
gui.intoxicantes.maquina.caldeirao_mostu: Ready to mash — malt + water below
gui.intoxicantes.maquina.dorna_bebida.fa: Empty — add cane juice or molasses
Fire out — the copper went cold
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.cachaca.fogo: The still needs FIRE below (campfire, fire or magma). Without heat the batch WAITS — no progress lost, it resumes when fire returns.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.cachaca.total: From cane to bottle: %s on the clock (crush 40s + ferment 7min + distill 1min30 + age %s). Config tunes everything.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.cerveja.agua: The beer cauldron only accepts the 1st dose with WATER below (source or filled copper cauldron). It's the mash dilution — no water, no beer.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.cerveja.total: From barley to bottle: %s on the clock (roast + mash 40s + boil 30s + ferment %s + condition 2min). Config tunes everything.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.rum.mesmo_alam: The still is GENERIC: the same copper machine that distills cane juice for cachaça distills fermented molasses for rum. The recipe decides the output — build ONE distilling station.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.rum.total: From cane to bottle: %s on the clock (crush 40s + cook the molasses + ferment 7min + distill 1min30 + age %s). Tradition charges the price — and pays in flavor. Config tunes everything.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.vinho.dois_est: The wine barrel FERMENTS first (bubbles and noise) and, when fermentation ends, moves to AGING on its own (cellar silence). No need to take anything out halfway — load it, wait, bottle.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.vinho.total: From grape to bottle: %s on the clock (press 40s + ferment %s + age 5min). The fastest drink in the distillery. Config tunes everything.
guia.intoxicantes.bebidas.vinho.adega: Press + wine barrel: just two machines and you have a whole cellar. Train grapes over fences: each root yields 1 grape, or 3 at maximum UV. See Crops → Grape arbor.
gui.intoxicantes.cardapio.exclusivos_vaz: The Gago has no exclusives — check the Dealer's spot.
item.intoxicantes.suco_detox.lore: §aThe regular's redemption: slowly heals your organs and quenches thirst.
item.intoxicantes.agua_de_coco.lore: §bThe backcountry isotonic: the best water on the corner.
effect.intoxicantes.viagem.baseado: §aThe mellow sets in... the world feels softer.
effect.intoxicantes.viagem.baseado.forte: §aDeep toke: HEAVY mellow, and the munchies came along.
effect.intoxicantes.viagem.opio: §6The warm blanket covers you: nothing hurts now.
effect.intoxicantes.viagem.opio.forte: §6Your body is warm lead: even the floor feels comfy.

effect.intoxicantes.viagem.cocaina: §fThe heart races: the world on fast-forward.
effect.intoxicantes.viagem.cocaina.forte: §fEVERYTHING TOO FAST: your heart is a machine gun and the world keeps up.
effect.intoxicantes.viagem.lsd: §dThe trip begins: don't stare at the sky too long.
effect.intoxicantes.viagem.lsd.forte: §dThe trip got HEAVY: walls melt and the big market crosses the sky.

effect.intoxicantes.queda.sonho: §8Back from the dream: hungry, slow and homesick.
effect.intoxicantes.queda.overdrive: §7The beat wore off: your body bills you for the party.
effect.intoxicantes.queda.viagem: §8The walls stopped melting... but the darkness says good morning.
effect.intoxicantes.sede.zerou: §cYou are DEHYDRATED: weakness, slowness and nausea. Drink something!
effect.intoxicantes.abstinencia.colapso: §4The withdrawal CRASH: your body is giving up. A dose would help... at a price.

effect.intoxicantes.vicio.curado: §aADDICTION CURED: your body forgave you. Don't waste it.
effect.intoxicantes.detox.bebeu: §aThe detox goes down easy: your organs thank you.
gui.intoxicantes.prontuario.veredito.4: §4"The Gago prays for you" - Dr. Gago

guia.intoxicantes.economia.peru.1: Peru travels with his small motorcycle near the Gago Market, villages and roads. Only a few appear in each region. Click him or his motorcycle while nearby to open the betting pad.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.peru.2: Choose one of 25 animal groups or a number from 00 to 99. The number determines its group: 01–04 is Ostrich; 97–99 and 00 are Cow. Enter a stake in the mod currency, review the gross prize and confirm the ticket. Only your internal balance is used.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.peru.3: The pad shows the day, time, limits and multipliers set by the server. One daily result applies to the entire world, generated by the server using the Minecraft clock. My bets shows your tickets; Results shows recent draws.
guia.intoxicantes.economia.peru.dica: Closing the menu or leaving the server does not cancel an accepted bet. Prizes are credited offline too. If your balance is full, a prize stays pending until there is room. The server owner can configure draw time and amounts.
